I couldn't confirm whether that means other members can find it. If it needs to be strictly private, I can delete it with gbrain `forget` (fact #1) and keep it out of the brain.
- **My reply to Ilse:** "Got it, Ilse. I've saved that your Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups go through Bay 30 from now on. I'll only use it when I'm helping you, and I won't share it anywhere else." That promise is about what I say and post. It doesn't change who can see the saved fact.
